subject: S20 touches notes/models.py (+store, routes) for video notes: anchor_pos {t}
body: Brief §5.4 needs notes with anchor_type 'video' and anchor_pos {t: seconds}. AnchorPos today requires from/to/quote, so I am adding a small VideoPos {t} model and an AnyPos union (AnchorPos | VideoPos) used by NoteOut/NoteCreate/NotePatch, check_shape (video anchors take VideoPos or none, others take AnchorPos or none), and the two model_validate sites in store.py/routes.py. Nothing else in your files changes; I keep your tests green and add mine. Shout if you are editing these lines.
